description:
Virtual PDF printer for Windows - print to PDF and hand it to a configurable target application.

miPDFconvert is a virtual PDF printer for Windows. Install it, print to the
miPDFconvert printer from any application, and get a PDF - either handed
automatically to a configurable target application or saved through a dialog.
The conversion uses miPDFlib - no Ghostscript or other external engine is
needed. The printer embeds the original fonts. Installer and binaries are
Authenticode-signed.
